body:

You have only been banned for a short while, and I believe that you must wait longer before you have a chance of being appealed. You obviously caused trouble, and you need to pay the 'price'.

-My minecraft ign is ThundaBolt_
-I was banned for Excessive Infractions
-Almost all my warnings i said sorry cuz i was just raging. Kicks and temp-bannes were appropriate, i agree though.
SR MOD+ please unban me because practically every other server is shit. Ind im bored AF.
Also, if im unbanned could cronus re-accept me?

~Thunda
